tests.name: Effective description
tests.message: Verdict not allowed for this test: 'warning' (allowed: passed, failed)

tests.name: Verbosity and conciseness
tests.reasoning: The body avoids explaining general concepts (e.g., what evaluation jobs are, what CloudWatch is) and jumps directly into domain-specific scope, check-ids, and routing rules specific to this skill's purpose.
tests.evidence: This skill owns **SageMaker-side** eval only; a Bedrock-native `CreateEvaluationJob` routes out.

tests.name: Detailed reference materials must not be in body
tests.reasoning: The check table and router are compact 'what it catches'/'first read' indexes, not full detection rules — the skill explicitly states the full six-column rules live in the reference file, not the body.
tests.evidence: The full six-column detection rules, remediations, and citations live in the reference — the table below is a what-it-catches index.

tests.name: Reference files must be linked
tests.reasoning: All five reference files (api-quirks.md, checks-sagemaker-evaluation.md, collection-reference.md, known-causes.md, metrics-and-logs.md) are linked via markdown links in the body.

tests.name: Reference links must specify when to load
tests.reasoning: Each reference link in the Router and Appendix sections is paired with a clear trigger condition for when to load it.
tests.evidence: Load [known-causes.md](references/known-causes.md) whenever the user names an error or symptom; match it to a section, check the cited AWS page...

tests.name: Reference path format
tests.reasoning: All reference links use relative paths from the skill root with the correct references/ prefix.

tests.name: Prescription vs description
tests.reasoning: Fragile/compliance-sensitive operations (read-only guardrails, check-id assignment, account ID masking) are prescriptive with exact rules, while diagnostic reasoning (matching symptoms, understanding causes) is explained with rationale rather than rigid steps.
tests.evidence: Never call `CreateTrainingJob`, `StopTrainingJob`, or any other mutating API. Recommend the fix and give the exact CLI/IaC command; let the user run it.

tests.name: Defaults, not menus
tests.reasoning: The skill does not present competing tool options as a menu; it routes to a single catalog and reference set per symptom with no equal alternatives.
tests.evidence: Router table maps each symptom to a single 'First read' and 'Load' reference, with no competing alternatives listed.

tests.name: Favor procedures over declarations
tests.reasoning: The skill teaches a generalizable diagnostic approach (symptom matching, confirming scope, checking collection APIs) applicable to any SageMaker eval job, rather than declaring a one-off task.
tests.evidence: Match the symptom, confirm with the collection calls, then report with the check-id and severity from the catalog.

tests.name: Gotchas section
tests.reasoning: The skill includes a dedicated 'Common wrong answers' section plus an Error Handling section with API-quirks-style traps, functioning as gotchas for this domain's non-obvious pitfalls.
tests.evidence: "No evaluation metrics were found, so the scores are zero." Absent datapoints in `LLMOps/Evaluation` mean the scores were never published, not a measured zero.
